# PLLM

Private LLM inference documentation. Public weights; provider follows the protocol.

- [Use the Agents SDK](/docs/client/agents/): Keep the Responses endpoint and tracing inside your chosen trust boundary.
- [Chat from the terminal](/docs/client/chat/): Stream a conversation without writing application code.
- [Configure once](/docs/client/configuration/): The SDK and chat CLI share the same local settings.
- [Install the client](/docs/client/install/): Use UV to install the CLI and Python client from this repository.
- [Follow a request](/docs/client/lifecycle/): From preparation to the text your application receives.
- [Use the OpenAI SDK](/docs/client/openai/): Point the standard SDK at your local gateway, not at the provider.
- [Python SDK](/docs/client/python/): Keep HE details out of application code.
- [Deploy with Docker](/docs/deployment/docker/): A provider container and a separate customer gateway.
- [Deployment overview](/docs/deployment/overview/): Separate the provider, trusted client, and documentation site.
- [Publish the documentation](/docs/deployment/site/): Build a static Fumadocs site and deploy through GitHub Pages.
- [Deploy with systemd](/docs/deployment/systemd/): Run the provider as a dedicated user with a protected environment file.
- [Start here](/docs/): A familiar API. A different privacy boundary.
- [Run your first private request](/docs/quickstart/): Start a provider, configure the client, and generate a response.
- [CLI reference](/docs/reference/cli/): The flags below come from the supplied parser.
- [Compatibility matrix](/docs/reference/compatibility/): What the supplied code implements, and what was actually exercised.
- [Project structure](/docs/reference/development/): Work on the Rust core, Python package, documentation and paper in one repository.
- [Build and release](/docs/reference/releasing/): GitHub checks, PyPI publication and Pages deployment.
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/reference/troubleshooting/): Resolve configuration and lifecycle failures without weakening the protocol.
- [How PLLM works](/docs/research/architecture/): A local Responses interface around a private matrix protocol.
- [Benchmarks](/docs/research/benchmarks/): Read the workload and denominator before reading the speedup.
- [Private LLM Inference](/docs/research/paper/): The full paper. Preparation, decoding, and the client and provider boundary.
- [Reproduce the study](/docs/research/reproduce/): Keep the experiment environment separate from the serving runtime.
- [Implementation roadmap](/docs/research/roadmap/): The next work follows measured costs, not a new model architecture.
- [Security boundaries](/docs/security/): Name the protected data, the adversary, and what still leaks.
- [Install a provider](/docs/server/install/): Build the Rust extension and load a supported checkpoint.
- [Model support](/docs/server/models/): Distinguish tensor import, graph execution, and quality validation.
- [Rust execution core](/docs/server/native/): Maturin packaging, integer kernels, backend inspection and measured comparisons.
- [Tune the right bottleneck](/docs/server/performance/): Measure the complete lifecycle before increasing a batch.
- [Run a provider](/docs/server/usage/): Declare the checkpoint policy and choose a supported execution path.
